name: eye_optical_realism_v2
prompt_translation: Use natural off-white sclera rather than luminous paper-white eye whites.
Give the iris subtle non-uniform radial texture and tonal variation without gemstone or glowing-eye rendering.
Make upper and lower eyelids physically wrap the eyeball with natural lid thickness and slight lower-lid volume.
Integrate lashes at real lash roots and keep catchlights consistent with the existing studio key light.
